Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.question: ১) If the length of a rectangle is halved and its breadth is tripled, what is the percentage change in its area?
Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.exp:
Let original length = 10
original breadth = 10
Then, original area = 10 × 10 = 100
Length is halved
⇒ New length = 10/2
= 5
breadth is tripled.
⇒ New breadth = 10 × 3
= 30
New area = 5 × 30
= 150
Increase in area
= new area - original area
= 150 - 100
= 50
Percentage increase in area
= {(increase in area/original area) × 100}%
= {(50/100) × 100}%
= 50%.

Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.question: ২) The diagonals of a rhombus are 72 cm and 30 cm respectively. What is its perimeter?
Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.exp:
In Rhombus
Let,
a = length of each side
b = base
h = height
d1,d2 are diagonals
Then Perimeter = 4a
= 2√(d12 + d22)

Perimeter = 2√(722 + 302)
= 156 cm.

Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.question: ৩) The base of a parallelogram is (p+4) Altitude to the base is (p−3) and the area is (p2−4). Find out its actual area:
Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.exp:
In Parallelogram
Let,
b and care sides
b = base
h = height
area = base × height
= b × h
Therefore,
p2 - 4 = (p + 4)(p - 3)
p2 - 4 = p2 + p - 12
p = 8
Hence, actual area
= (p2 - 4) = 82 - 4
= 64 - 4
= 60 square units.

Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.question: ৪) A rectangular plot measuring 90 metres by 50 metre needs to be enclosed by wire fencing such that poles of the fence will be kept 5 metres apart. How many poles will be needed?
Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.exp:
Length of the wire fencing
= perimeter
= 2(90+50)
= 280
Two poles are kept 5 metres apart.
Note that the poles are placed along the perimeter of the rectangular plot, not in a single straight line.
Hence, the number of poles required
= 280/5
= 56.

Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.question: ৫) A tank is 25 metres long, 12 metres wide and 6 metres deep. What is the cost of plastering its walls and bottom at the rate of 75 paise per square metre?
Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.exp:
Consider a rectangular solid of length l, width w and height h. Then,
Total Surface Area
= 2lw + 2lh + 2wh
= 2(lw + lh + wh)
Volume = lwh
In this case, l = 25, w = 12 m and h = 6 m and all surfaces needs to be plastered except the top.
Hence, the total area to be plastered
total surface area - an area of the top face
= 2(lw + lh + wh) - lw
= lw + 2lh + 2hw
= (25 × 12) + 2 × (25 × 6) + 2 × (12 × 6)
= 300 + 300 + 144
= 744
Cost of plastering
= 744 × 75
= 55800 Paisa
= Tk. 558

Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.question: ৬) The area of a parallelogram is 72 square centimetre and its altitude is twice the corresponding base. What is the length of the base?
Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.exp:
Let, base = x
Then, height = 2x
Area = base × height
= x × 2x
= 2x2
Area is given as 72 cm2
2x2 = 72 cm2
⇒ x2 = 36 cm2
⇒ x = 6 cm
Hence, the length of the base is 6 cm.

Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.question: ৭) The ratio between the length and the breadth of a rectangular park is 3:2. If a man cycling along the boundary of the park at the speed of 12km/hr completes one round in 8 minutes, then what is the area of the park in a square metre?
Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.exp:
Let length = 3x km,
breadth = 2x km
Distance travelled by the man at the speed of 12 km/hr in 8 minutes
12 × (8/60) × 1000
= 1600 m
But the total distance travelled
= 2(3x + 2x)
= 10x
Therefore,
10x = 1600
x = 160
Area = 3x × 2x = 6x2
= 6 × 1602
= 6 × 25600
= 153600 m2

Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.question: ৮) What is the percentage increase in the area of a rectangle if each of its sides is increased by 20%?
Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.exp:
Let original length = 10
original breadth = 10
Then, original area
= 10 × 10
= 100
Length is increased by 20%
⇒ New length = 10 + 2 (2 is 20% of 10)
= 12
Breadth is increased by 20%
⇒ New breadth = 10 + 2 (2 is 20% of 10)
= 12
New area = 12 × 12
= 144
Increase in are =
= new area - original area
= 144 - 100
= 44
Percentage increase in area
= (increase in area/original area) × 100
= {(44/100) × 100}%
= 44%

Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.question: ৯) The length of a rectangular plot is 20 metres more than its breadth. If the cost of fencing the plot at the rate of Tk. 26.50 per metre is Tk.5300, what is the length of the plot in metre?
Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.exp:
Length of the fence = 5300/26.50
= 200 m
⇒ 2(length + breadth) = 200
⇒ length + breadth = 100
⇒ length + length - 20 = 100 [ breadth = length - 20]
⇒ 2 length = 120
⇒ length = 60 m.

Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.question: ১০) A large field of 700 hectares is divided into two parts. The difference between the areas of the two parts is one-fifth of the average of the two areas. What is the area of the smaller part in hectares?
Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.exp:
Let, the area of larger part = x hector
∴ area of smaller part = (700 - x) hectors
The difference between the areas of the two parts
= x - (700 - x)
= 2x - 700
One-fifth of the average of the two areas
(1/5) × (700/2) [total area = 700]
= 70
Given that difference of the areas of the two parts = one-fifth of the average of the two areas
2x−700 = 70
⇒ 2x = 770
⇒ x = 385.

∴ Smaller part of the land is = (700 - 385) = 315 hectares.

Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.question: ১২) An observer 2m tall is 10√3 m away from a tower. The angle of elevation from his eye to the top of the tower is 30°. The height of the tower is:
Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.exp:
SR = PQ = 2 m

1/√3 = TS/10√3
TS = 10√3/√3

Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.question: ১৩) When the sun's altitude changes from 30° to 60°, the length of the shadow of a tower decreases by 70m. What is the height of the tower?
Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.exp:
Let AD be the tower, BD be the initial shadow and CD be the final shadow.
Given that BC = 70 m
∠ABD = 30°
∠ACD = 60°
Let CD = x, AD = h
From the right ⊿CDA
tan 60° = AD/CD
√3 = h/x ......eq(1)
From the right ⊿BDA
tan30° = AD/BD
1/√3 = h/(70 + x) ........ eq(2)
eq(1)/eq(2)
√3/(1/√3) = (h/x)/{h/(70+x)}
3 = 70 + x/x
2x = 70
x = 35
Substituting this value of x in eq:1, we have
√3 = h/35
h = 35√3
= 60.55 m

Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.question: ১৫) The angle of elevation of a ladder leaning against a wall is 60° and the foot of the ladder is 4.6 m away from the wall. The length of the ladder is -
Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.exp:
ধরি,
AB হচ্ছে দেয়াল এবং BC হচ্ছে মই।
এখানে ∠ACB = 60° এবং AC = 4.6 মিটার
তাহলে, AC/BC = cos 60° = 1/2 [ যেহেতু, cosθ = ভূমি/অতিভুজ]
⇒ BC = 2 × AC
∴ BC = 2 × 4.6
= 9.2m

Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.question: ১৬) In triangle ABC, AB = AC. All of the following statement is true except -
Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.exp:
প্রদত্ত শর্তানুযায়ী চিত্রটি অঙ্কন করা হলোঃ
আমরা জানি, ত্রিভুজের দুই বাহুর সমষ্টি তৃতীয় বাহু অপেক্ষা বৃহত্তর।
সেই হিসেবে অপশন ক) এবং খ) সত্যি বলে বাদ।
অপশন (ঘ) এর ক্ষেত্রে AB = AC বলে বামপক্ষ = AC + BC = AB + BC = ডানপক্ষ।
সুতরাং উত্তর BC + AC > AB + BC

Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.question: ১৭) Three angles of a triangle are in proportion 5:6:7. Then what is the difference in degrees between the biggest and the smallest angles?
Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.exp:
অনুপাতগুলোর যোগফল = 18
তিন কোণের সমষ্টি = 180°
∴ বড় কোণের পরিমাণ = (7 × 180)/18
= 70°
ছোট কোণের পরিমাণ = (5 × 180)/18
= 50°
∴ বড় কোণ ও ছোট কোণের পার্থক্য = 70° - 50°
= 20°.

Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.question: ১৮) If a cube has a length of 8 cm, what is its total surface area?
Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.exp:
ঘনকের একবাহুর দৈর্ঘ্য a হলে তার সমগ্রতলের ক্ষেত্রফল হবে 6a2 বর্গএকক।
= 6 × (8)2 cm2
= 6 × 64 cm2
= 384 cm2

Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.question: ১৯) The difference between the radii of the bigger circle and the smaller circle is 14 cm and the difference between their areas is 1,056 cm2. The radius of the smaller circle is -
Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.exp:
ধরি,
ক্ষুদ্রতর বৃত্তের ব্যাসার্ধ r cm
∴ বৃহত্তর বৃত্তের ব্যাসার্ধ = (r + 14) cm
প্রশ্নমতে, Π(r + 14)2-Πr2 = 1056
Π{r2 + 2b × r × 14 + (14)2 - r2} = 1056
r2 + 28r + 196 - r2 = 1056/Π
28r + 196 = 1056/(22/7)
= 1056 × (7/22)
= 336
28r = 336 - 196
= 140
∴ r = 140/28
= 5
অতএব, ক্ষুদ্রতর বৃত্তের ব্যাসার্ধ 5 cm.

Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.question: ২০) A person rides a bicycle around a circular path of radius 50m. The radius of the bicycle wheel of the bicycle is 50 cm. The cycle comes to the starting point for the first time in 1 hour. What is the number of revolutions of the wheel in 15 minutes?
Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.exp:
দেওয়া আছে,
বৃত্তকার মাঠের ব্যাসার্ধ r1 = 50 m
বৃত্তকার মাঠের পরিধি, 2πr1 = 2 × π × 50
= 100π m.
সাইকেলের চাকার ব্যাসার্ধ, r2 = 50 cm = 0.5 m.
∴ সাইকেলের চাকার পরিধি, 2πr2 = 2 × π × 0.5
= π m.
এখন চাকাটি π মিটার গেলে ঘুরবে = 1 বার।
∴ চাকাটি 100π গেলে ঘুরবে = 1 × 100×π
= 100 বার।
এখন, 60 মিনিটে চাকাটি ঘুরবে = 100 বার।
∴ 15 মিনিটে চাকাটি ঘুরবে = (100 × 15)/60
= 25 বার।

Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.question: ২১) An acute angled triangle ABC, If sin2(A + B - C) = 1 and tan (B + C - A) = √3, then the value of angle ∠B is -
Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.exp:
দেওয়া আছে,
sin2(A + B + C) = 1
⇒ sin 2(A + B + C) = sin 90°
⇒ 2(A + B + C) = 90°
∴ (A + B + C) = 45°............(i)
আবার, tan (B + C - A) = √3
⇒ tan (B + C - A) = tan60°(tan 60° = √3)
B + C - A = 60°............(ii)
এখন, (i) ও (ii) নং সমীকরণ যোগ করে পাই,
(A + B - C) + (B + C - A) = 45° + 60°
⇒2B = 105°
⇒ B = 52(1/2)°

Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.question: ২২) If Ab and CD are two diameters of a circle of radius r and they are mutually perpendicular, then what is the ratio of the area of the circle to the area of the ΔACD?
Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.exp:
ধরি,
O কেন্দ্রবিশিষ্ট বৃত্তে ADC একটি ত্রিভুজ।
বৃত্তের ব্যাসার্ধ r
এখানে,
ব্যাসার্ধ OA = OD = OC = r
ব্যাস, AB = DC = 2r
এখানে, বৃত্তের ক্ষেত্রফল = πr2 বর্গএকক
এখন, ΔACD এর ক্ষেত্রফল = 1/2 × ভূমি × উচ্চতা
= 1/2 × 2r × r
= r2
বৃত্তের ক্ষেত্রফলঃ ΔACD এর ক্ষেত্রফল
= πr2/r2
= π.

Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.question: ২৪) If sinA + sin<sup>2</sup>A = 1. Then the value of the expression (cos<sup>2</sup>A + cos<sup>4</sup>A) is -
Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.exp:
দেওয়া আছে,
sinA + sin2A = 1
⇒ sinA = 1 - sin2A
⇒ sinA = cos2A
এখন,
cos2A + Cos4A
= cos2A + cos2A.cos2A
= cos2A + sinA.sinA [sina = cos2A]
= Cos2A + sin2A

Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.question: ২৫) A metal cube of edge 12 cm is melted and formed into three smaller cubes. If the edges of two smaller cubes are 6cm and 8 cm, find the edges of the third smaller cube.
Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.exp:
Let,
The edge of the third small cube be x cm
The volume of the cube = (edge)3
According to the question,
63 + 83 + x3 = 123
⇒ 216 + 512 + x3 = 1728
⇒ x3 = 1728 - 728
= 1000
⇒ x = 1000(1/3)
⇒ x = 10 cm.

Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.question: ২৬) The base of a right prism is a trapezium whose lengths of two parallels sides are 10 cm and 6 cm and distance between them is 5 cm. If the height of the prism is 8 cm, its volume is -
Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.exp:
Length of the parallel sides of prism = 10 cm and 6 cm
Height of prism = 8 cm
∴ Volume of prism = (1/2){(10 + 6) × 5 × 8}
= (1/2) × 16 × 5 × 8
= 320 cm3

Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.question: ২৭) If a - b = 6 and a<sup>2</sup>+b<sup>2</sup> = 116, then what is the value of ab?
Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.exp:
(a - b)2 = a2 - 2ab + b2
⇒ 62 = (a2 + b2) - 2ab
⇒ 62 = 116 - 2ab
⇒ 36 = 116 - 2ab
⇒ 2ab = 116 - 36
⇒ 2ab = 80
⇒ ab = 40.

Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.question: ২৮) If a/b + b/a = 2, then the value of (a - b) is -
Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.exp:
Given,
a/b + b/a = 2
⇒ (a2 + b2)/ab = 2
⇒ (a2 + b2) = 2ab
⇒ a2 + b2 - 2ab = 0
⇒ (a - b)2 = 0
⇒ a - b = 0.

Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.question: ২৯) 20 + 8 × 0.5/(20 - ?) = 12. Find the value in place of (?).
Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.exp:
Let the missing number be x.
Given,
20 + 8 × 0.5/(20 - x) = 12
⇒ (20 + 4)/(20 - x) = 12
⇒ 24/(20 - x) = 12
⇒ 20 - x = 24/12
⇒ 20 - x = 2
⇒ x = 20 - 2
⇒ x = 18.

Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.question: ৩০) If x + y + z = 0, then, x<sup>3</sup> + y<sup>3</sup> + z<sup>3</sup> + 3xyz is equal to -
Equation Solving, Geometry, Trigonometry.exp:
As we know,
a3 + b3 + c3 - 3abc = a2 + b2 + c2 - ab - bc - ca(a + b + c)
when (a + b + c) = 0
Then a3 + b3 + c3 - 3abc = 0
When x + y + z = 0
⇒ x3 + y3 + z3 = 3xyz
⇒ x3 + y3 + z3 + 3xyz = 3xyz +3xyz
= 6xyz.
